# Comparing potency

## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

### Diabetes

```{r}
# Differences in HRs/ORs reported
# Relative potency calculation

# BPS
# Korea ORs
# BPS relative potency values

RP_BPS_values <- c(
  Korea = log(2.13) / log(1.44),
  
  France_Q2 = log(2.81) / log(2.56),
  France_Q3 = log(2.81) / log(2.35),
  France_Q4 = log(2.81) / log(1.56)
)

RP_BPS <- c(
  lower = min(RP_BPS_values),
  median = median(RP_BPS_values),
  upper = max(RP_BPS_values)
)



# BPF
# Korea ORs
log(1.43)/log(1.44) # = 0.9808891


```

```{r}
# Scenarios
RP_BPS
# mean and median are almost the same

RP_BPF <- c(0, 0.5, 1)
```

```{r}

# Bisphenol concentrations from fathers
BPA_f <- 1.46
BPS_f <- 0.29
BPF_f <- 0.23

# Bisphenol concentrations from mothers
BPA_m <- 0.61
BPS_m <- 0.18
BPF_m <- 0.05


df_bisphenol_eq <- bind_rows(
  tibble(group = "Fathers", analog = "BPS",
         BPA_original = BPA_f, analog_current = BPS_f, RP = RP_BPS),
  tibble(group = "Fathers", analog = "BPF",
         BPA_original = BPA_f, analog_current = BPF_f, RP = RP_BPF),
  tibble(group = "Mothers", analog = "BPS",
         BPA_original = BPA_m, analog_current = BPS_m, RP = RP_BPS),
  tibble(group = "Mothers", analog = "BPF",
         BPA_original = BPA_m, analog_current = BPF_m, RP = RP_BPF)
) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_analog_eq = BPA_original * RP + analog_current,
    
    replacement_analog_eq = BPA_original + analog_current,
    
    pct_change_vs_baseline =
      ((replacement_analog_eq - baseline_analog_eq) /
         baseline_analog_eq) * 100
  )
    
```

## BPA equivalents

```{r}
df_bisphenol_RP <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    group = "Fathers",
    analog = "BPS",
    BPA_original = BPA_f,
    replacement_exposure = BPA_f,
    RP = RP_BPS
  ),
  tibble(
    group = "Fathers",
    analog = "BPF",
    BPA_original = BPA_f,
    replacement_exposure = BPA_f,
    RP = RP_BPF
  ),
  tibble(
    group = "Mothers",
    analog = "BPS",
    BPA_original = BPA_m,
    replacement_exposure = BPA_m,
    RP = RP_BPS
  ),
  tibble(
    group = "Mothers",
    analog = "BPF",
    BPA_original = BPA_m,
    replacement_exposure = BPA_m,
    RP = RP_BPF
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    BPA_equivalent_after_replacement = replacement_exposure * RP,
    pct_change_vs_BPA =
      ((BPA_equivalent_after_replacement - BPA_original) / BPA_original) * 100
  )

df_bisphenol_RP <- bind_rows(
  tibble(group = "Fathers", analog = "BPS",
         BPA_original = BPA_f, analog_current = BPS_f, RP = RP_BPS),
  tibble(group = "Fathers", analog = "BPF",
         BPA_original = BPA_f, analog_current = BPF_f, RP = RP_BPF),
  tibble(group = "Mothers", analog = "BPS",
         BPA_original = BPA_m, analog_current = BPS_m, RP = RP_BPS),
  tibble(group = "Mothers", analog = "BPF",
         BPA_original = BPA_m, analog_current = BPF_m, RP = RP_BPF)
) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_BPAeq = BPA_original + analog_current * RP,
    replacement_BPAeq = (BPA_original + analog_current) * RP,
    pct_change_vs_baseline =
      ((replacement_BPAeq - baseline_BPAeq) / baseline_BPAeq) * 100
  )
```

# NEW VERSION

```{r}
# BPS potency relative to BPA
# numerator = BPS effect
# denominator = BPA effect

RP_BPS_vs_BPA_values <- c(
  Korea = log(2.13) / log(1.44),
  France_Q2 = log(2.81) / log(2.56),
  France_Q3 = log(2.81) / log(2.35),
  France_Q4 = log(2.81) / log(1.56)
)

RP_BPS_vs_BPA <- c(
  lower = min(RP_BPS_vs_BPA_values),
  median = median(RP_BPS_vs_BPA_values),
  upper = max(RP_BPS_vs_BPA_values)
)

df_bisphenol_BPS_eq <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    group = "Fathers",
    BPA_original = BPA_f,
    BPS_current = BPS_f,
    RP_BPS_vs_BPA = RP_BPS_vs_BPA
  ),
  tibble(
    group = "Mothers",
    BPA_original = BPA_m,
    BPS_current = BPS_m,
    RP_BPS_vs_BPA = RP_BPS_vs_BPA
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Amount of BPS needed to give the same estimated effect as the original BPA
    BPA_as_BPS_eq = BPA_original / RP_BPS_vs_BPA,
    
    # Current mixed exposure expressed as BPS-equivalents
    current_mixed_BPS_eq = BPA_as_BPS_eq + BPS_current,
    
    # Actual BPS dose after full 1:1 replacement of BPA by BPS
    BPS_replacement_dose = BPA_original + BPS_current,
    
    pct_change_replacement_vs_current_mixed =
      ((BPS_replacement_dose - current_mixed_BPS_eq) /
         current_mixed_BPS_eq) * 100
  )
```
